sentences.en: We made arrangements to meet at 6 p.m. on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们计划在周一晚上六点见面。

sentences.en: My brother saw to all the arrangements for the party.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥负责了派对的所有安排。

sentences.en: Emily is very interested in tea ceremony and flower arrangement.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽非常感兴趣茶道和插花。
